better_answer_example: In my final year project, I worked as a business analyst on a student management system for an educational institution. My role involved gathering requirements, creating user stories, and collaborating with the development team to ensure user acceptance testing. One challenge we faced was maintaining UI consistency, which required iterative changes and feedback from stakeholders. Through this experience, I learned the importance of effective communication, adaptability, and attention to detail in business analysis, skills that I believe are essential for a business analyst role.
